quotes.text: Instead of flipping between a picture and the real object, they compare them in the same view. Fewer switches in focus means fewer missed steps.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the core productivity benefit of in-context instructions.

quotes.text: With Dynamics 365 Guides, you wear a Microsoft HoloLens headset. You can still see the real machine, the tools and the people around you, but digital instruction cards and 3D objects appear within that view.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Plain-English description of how Guides works on HoloLens.

quotes.text: A guide gives repeatable instructions for work the team already knows. Teams connects the operator with a person when the equipment, condition, or question falls outside those steps.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies the split between structured guides and live expert help.

quotes.text: This is why preparation matters more than AI excitement. For a safety or repair task, you need trusted source material, clear ownership, and human checks.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Grounds AI assistance in trusted content and human responsibility.

quotes.text: The goal isn't to keep an old app running for its own sake. It's to protect the knowledge people need when they're standing in front of the equipment.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Key advice for planning around the Guides end-of-availability date.

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Guides placed step-by-step holographic instructions, photos, videos and 3D models directly in the worker's view on Microsoft HoloLens, keeping hands free.
Experts authored guides in the PC app and anchored them in the real workspace with HoloLens, while Microsoft Teams calls brought in remote experts for unexpected problems.
Microsoft has set December 31, 2026 as the end of availability for Guides and Remote Assist, so organisations should inventory and preserve the task knowledge stored in their guides.
hook: Frontline technicians often juggle manuals, laptops and memory while doing careful physical work. In this Simply Explained episode, Mirko Peters explains how Dynamics 365 Guides used mixed reality on HoloLens, Teams and Copilot to bring instructions to the job, and what operations teams must do before the end-of-availability date.
